title: Cabinet visual world
question: Choose the visual world for the business cabinet redesign (calendar, settings, staff). Re-roll allowed.

options.label: Station Clipboard Rack
options.lineage: salon / workshop station clipboard with metal clip and swap-in shift sheets
options.thesis: The cabinet is a rack of station clipboards: cool quiet canvas, Together orange only as tag and CTA, calendar reads as a shift sheet.
options.viewport: Header with logo and monochrome menu; bookmarks as clip tabs; full-width month calendar as the shift sheet with a printed today ring and dense cells without peach gradients.
options.risk: Can feel too B2B-gray if the orange signal is too rare.

raised.raise: Shift status prints as a status line under the header (busy / free / waiting), not rainbow icons.
Day grid carries a now chase strip on the current slot, like a step-row playhead.
Booking duration in day-detail is encoded as block length, not only time text.
Color is spent once: orange only on CTA, today, and active bookmark; everything else bone/graphite.
The date grid is the primary axis; today is a printed ring; past days quiet toward the board.

options.label: Appointment Ledger Desk
options.lineage: paper appointment ledger on a salon or garage counter
options.thesis: The cabinet feels like an open appointment ledger: dense Manrope type, cool desk surface, orange pencil accent on actions.
options.viewport: Calendar as a full-width ledger spread; thin master filter column; settings and staff as calm blank forms without peach-card noise.
options.risk: Most familiar online-booking direction — familiar-default risk.

options.label: Merchant Calendar Pad
options.thesis: Quiet Together mark above; tear-off date pad below as the only instrument.
options.viewport: Month as pad under the logo; day-detail tears a leaf into a modal.
options.case: Strong owner ID with calendars; weaker clarity vs peach anti-reference (warm board).
options.risk: Easy slide back into cream wallpaper.

options.label: Shift Step Row
options.thesis: The day is a step row; chase light is now; slots are armed keys.
options.viewport: Intervals and day as instrument row; month stays overview above the console.
options.case: Excellent time clarity; weaker for settings/staff forms.
options.risk: Dark console may fight light-first cabinet and Capacitor.

options.label: Duration Staff Score
options.thesis: Bookings are duration blocks on a day staff; staff members are parallel columns.
options.viewport: Day as duration staff; month as score index.
options.case: Max duration clarity; weaker audience ID (score literacy).
options.risk: May feel abstract for salon owners.

options.label: Ops Phosphor Log
options.case: Salon/cafe owners do not identify with a machine-room terminal.
options.kept: States print as a line, icons do not decorate.

options.label: Glyph Density Scene
options.case: Zero product clarity for client booking.
options.kept: Density as signal — carried into calendar cell weight.

options.label: Gravity Rain Garden
options.case: Breaks Operate clarity and brand pins.
options.kept: One dominant force per screen — one primary job.

canonCard.label: Category standard
canonCard.thesis: Quiet booking SaaS cabinet: white canvas, neutral top nav, brand primary — competitor craft executed well.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar + month calendar card + day side panel.
